_comment: Gancio instances (https://gancio.org) - self-hosted AGPL event software used by social centres, DIY venues and neighbourhood collectives. One URL pattern, no key: {base}/api/events?start=<unix>&end=<unix>&max=<n>. Almost every event carries place.latitude/longitude, so these need no geocoding. robots.txt on every instance checked is byte-identical and allows everything, with no crawl-delay; the 2s here is politeness toward volunteer-run servers, several on home connections. default_city/region/country only fill gaps - Gancio's own place.address is used when present. There is no public directory API (gancio.org/instances is HTML), so this list is seeded by hand; add instances as they are verified.

sites.name: Calendari.cc (Valencia)
sites._note: Gancio instance: libertarian/social-centre agenda for Valencia (casals, ateneus, assemblies, free classes); robots.txt allows /api. Fills Valencia's grassroots gap.

sites.name: Agenda Henares (Alcalá de Henares)
sites._note: Gancio instance: self-managed activist and cultural agenda for the Henares valley (Madrid region); robots.txt allows /api. Free workshops, language exchanges, family play groups.

sites.name: Enredad (Spain)
sites._note: Gancio instance: queer, feminist and racialised community events across Spain (Madrid, Barcelona, Málaga, Murcia...); robots.txt allows /api. Most events carry coordinates.

sites.name: Convoca Málaga (ES)
sites._note: Gancio instance (convoca.la network): self-managed social and cultural agenda for Málaga; robots.txt allows /api. Sibling of the configured bcn/mad instances.

sites.name: Convoca Tramuntana (Girona)
sites._note: Gancio instance (convoca.la network): social-movement agenda for the Girona counties; robots.txt allows /api. Tenant assemblies, talks, community sport.

sites.name: Convoca Eivissa i Formentera (ES)
sites._note: Gancio instance (convoca.la network): community agenda for Ibiza and Formentera; robots.txt allows /api. Community garden open days, second-hand markets.

sites.name: event.cologne (Cologne)
sites._note: Gancio instance for Cologne: city libraries, Rathaus science talks, botanic-garden tours, Hänneschen, Karneval; 426 events in 180 days, 207 tagged EintrittFrei, 96% with coordinates. robots.txt allows all.

sites.name: Wedel Veranstaltungen (Wedel, Hamburg metro)
sites._note: Gancio calendar for Wedel (Pinneberg district, Hamburg metro): VHS talks and courses, sustainability series, DRK meeting centre, church events, excursions; 509 events in 180 days, all with coordinates. robots.txt allows all.

sites.name: Fahrradtermine Berlin
sites._note: Gancio calendar of Berlin cycling groups: ADFC and Changing Cities district groups, bike demos, Critical Mass, self-help bike workshop; 40 upcoming, 25 with coordinates (online ones drop). robots.txt allows all.

sites.name: FOMO RheinMain
sites._note: Grassroots Gancio for Rhein-Main culture: Kreativfabrik and Schlachthof Wiesbaden, NAXOS Frankfurt, Mainz and Darmstadt collectives; 134 events in 180 days, 93 with coordinates; many concerts ticketed. robots.txt allows all.

sites.name: Sprachtreffen.de (language cafés)
sites._note: Gancio listing free language cafés and tandem meetups in neighbourhood centres and libraries, about a third in Berlin, the rest across DE/AT/CH; 92 upcoming, 45 with coordinates. robots.txt allows all.
